name: Measurabl
positioning: ESG data for real estate assets, structured for the investor questionnaire that has to be answered every year.
description: Measurabl collects utility and building data, calculates emissions and performance metrics, and produces the disclosures real estate investors are asked for — GRESB, CDP, investor reporting — with physical climate risk scoring and decarbonisation pathway modelling on top.
real_estate_use: A fund's ESG reporting cycle used to mean chasing utility bills across dozens of assets every spring. Measurabl automates the collection, standardises the metrics across countries and unit systems, and generates the submission. The second use is capital planning: modelling which retrofits move an asset off a stranding trajectory before a regulation or a buyer forces the issue.
features: Automated utility data collection and normalisation
Emissions accounting across scopes with portfolio roll-up
GRESB, CDP and investor disclosure reporting
Physical climate risk scoring per asset
Decarbonisation pathway and stranding risk modelling

use_cases.job: Produce a GRESB submission without chasing utility bills across the portfolio
Identify which assets are on a stranding trajectory and what fixes them
